Use case: game pixel-art asset set. Reference image shows the THREE ORIGINAL Frost Crystal towers assembled. Preserve their recognizable grey/slate stepped pedestal, octagonal open well and hovering faceted crystal identity. Design ONE higher-level evolutionary skin, not another tower family.
Reinforced early jade frost tower. Grey stone pedestal with two sturdy dark iron corner braces and a low octagonal mint-green well. Three clear green inlays on the short front. A single emerald-to-pale-mint diamond crystal with two broad clean facets; still simple, slightly wider shoulders than the original third crystal. No gold. Crystal target visible28x44 pixels.
CRITICAL COMPACT SIZE: same footprint as original64px wide. The pedestal is ONLY64x82 native pixels high: SHORT lower wall/very short stairs, no added floors, no tall outer parapets, no elevated crown. It must not grow upwards or sideways versus other upgrades. Evolution via construction/materials and distinct crystal silhouette only. Original three-quarter top-down game view, front centered, straight vertical sides, NOT isometric diamonds.
OUTPUT TWO SEPARATE COMPONENTS, horizontally arranged on a landscape transparent canvas: LEFT the complete EMPTY pedestal/well with NO hovering crystal; RIGHT the isolated hovering crystal only, fully detached. Pedestal is taller/larger than crystal. Both centered in their own well-separated regions, no overlap. Crystal tip points UP, centered upright, no pedestal beneath it. Do not include a third assembled tower.
Style: deliberate chunky native pixel clusters, crisp square edges, compact 2–3 tone surfaces, dark plum outlines, limited palette matching reference. Native design about64px body width shown enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor pixels. No soft shading, blur, gradients, photographic lighting, particle fog, huge glow, sparkles, text, labels, numbers, ground, background, checkerboard, shadow beneath objects, or borders. Genuine transparent alpha. All components fully inside canvas with transparent margins. Keep decorations broad and legible at small mobile game size.
